card.name: Slot before a word like recognize
card.fires_on: Small words (I, she, be, clinically, may) right before a likely 'recognize/recognized' or similar verb, such as 'something I recognize' or 'clinically recognized pregnancies'.

modes.label: Pronoun before recognize
modes.description: A pronoun or helper word where 'recognize' or 'know again' is expected next.

modes.label: clinically before recognized
modes.description: The adverb 'clinically' just before 'recognized pregnancies' in birth-defect risk statements.
modes.example: miscarriage in<< clinically>> recognized pregnancies is 2 to 4

modes.label: be before found/heard
modes.description: The word 'be' after 'can often' in bird descriptions, before a verb like found or heard.
modes.example: Northern Flickers can often <<be>> found on the ground

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying recognize, recognition or recognized next.
